text:
Marta: heads-up — onboarding sample for Cloudflare Workers is failing in preview. Root errors: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` and intermittent `TypeError: request body stream closed`.
Jon: classic Node->edge incompat. Is the sample bundling for webworker?
Marta: we built with esbuild --platform=browser but didn't inject shims. bundle is ESM.
Priya: browser platform can still pull node:crypto transitively. We solved it by adding a small `crypto-subtle` adapter and passing it into the client during init.
Jon: also check setImmediate usage — CF has no setImmediate. Use a fallback: `const setImmediate = globalThis.setImmediate ?? (fn => queueMicrotask(fn));`.
Theo: streaming note — CF uses WHATWG streams. If SDK relies on Node stream.Transform, convert to webstreams with a tiny helper `nodeStreamToWeb`.
CI-bot: deploy-preview created for marta/cf-fix-42 — smoke tests running.
Marta: tried `import { Buffer } from 'buffer'` but a transitive dep imports `node:crypto`. We aliased `node:crypto` to `./shims/crypto-subtle.js` in bundler and it helped.
Priya: typing/troubleshooting tip — Wrangler complains `Cannot use import statement outside a module` unless `wrangler.toml` has `type = "esm"` and the artifact is ESM. Add that to sample README.
Jon: proposal: add optional client option `runtime: 'node'|'webworker'` so SDK can avoid Node APIs when targeting webworker.
Theo: leave a failing streaming unit test that asserts ReadableStream usage — will prevent regressions.
CI-bot: CI report: 11/12 checks passed (streaming-smoke failing).
Marta: logged preview stack: `TypeError: TransformStream is not constructible` — preview maybe supplied a non-standard polyfill. Filed issue #1012 with logs and preview link.
Priya: next steps: Jon opens SDK PR for runtime flag, Theo adds failing test, I'll update the sample README and shims folder. Leaving preview up until streaming test is green. :thumbsup:
